title: Probability under Boolean mask selection
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean mask and let $A$ be any predicate on finite Boolean words. Apply the mask to a uniformly random Boolean word of length equal to the mask length, retaining precisely the bits whose mask entries are true. The probability that the resulting word satisfies $A$ equals the probability that a uniformly random Boolean word of length equal to the number of true entries in the mask satisfies $A$.
hypotheses_covered: The mask is a finite Boolean word
$A$ is a predicate on Boolean words
